decisions.reason: As a newly launched multi-model safety shoe line in the firm's core category, it is likely to be retained unless early sales are clearly disappointing.
The comfort insole fits the firm's footwear ecosystem, but as an accessory it is easier to rationalize than core shoe lines if demand overlaps with other insole offers.
The supportive insole supports cross-selling with work shoes, though adjacent insole products give management some scope to consolidate if the range becomes too fragmented.
An ergonomic safety shoe series with its own page suggests strategic importance and differentiation in the firm's main business, making withdrawal unlikely so soon after launch.
Firefighter and rescue boots are specialized but strongly aligned with protective footwear expertise, so the firm would usually give this line time to build in its niche markets.
Because the moulded insole was presented as a flagship direction and highlighted on the home page, management would be very unlikely to remove it within a year.
